name: Perales de Tajuña (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green horizontal stripe of one fifth across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Perales de Tajuña (a castle on a mount on red).
history: Perales de Tajuña adopted its arms and flag officially on 1 July 1991, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 29 August 1991; the flag is of proportion 2:3, yellow with a green fess of one fifth of its width, and the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.
